Because the whisper decay is applied at each close, the echo audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 11% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Bonded capital sits idle for 10 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
